Open-source releases mean publicly reusable code or model weights under an open-source license. Transparency is a related but distinct measure.
For this ongoing observation, use the latest public comparative reporting cycle before the post: the September 2023 transparency assessment, supplemented by releases through March 6, 2024.
The comparative claim is tested against major foundation-model developers. This is a practical comparison group, not a census of every AI company.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Substantial continuing releases undermine the abandonment claim, or a credible contemporary comparison places OpenAI outside the least-open group. Contradicting either component defeats the combined claim, without establishing that OpenAI was generally open.
